guardrails: no semantic ingredient equivalence or post-hoc aliases
risk-surface coverage is reported separately from exact ingredient identity
false-positive question burden is reported alongside coverage
initial-stage and eventual-stage question coverage must not be conflated
holdout is rejected while metric definitions are under development

metric_policy.identity: Exact normalized ingredient-name matching remains the identity metric. No semantic or benchmark-specific ingredient aliases are introduced.
metric_policy.negative_burden: False-positive rates use only hidden_truth_complete meals with no present hidden ingredients, so absence is treated as a negative label only when explicitly complete.
metric_policy.question_stage: oracle-progressed staged state; measures hidden-question reachability after resolvable earlier blockers are progressed
metric_policy.risk_surface: A hidden-positive meal is risk-surfaced when the system emits any hidden-risk signal or HIDDEN_INGREDIENT question. This does not claim the ingredient identity is correct.

exact_question_calorie_weighted_coverage.exclusion: hidden ingredients without calorie truth are excluded from the kcal denominator

exact_question_recall.exclusion: only exact normalized ingredient names in generated HIDDEN_INGREDIENT questions count

exact_recognition_calorie_weighted_cover.exclusion: hidden ingredients without calorie truth are excluded from the kcal denominator

exact_recognition_recall.exclusion: only ground-truth hidden ingredients marked present are evaluated

mean_hidden_questions_per_complete_negat.exclusion: only hidden_truth_complete meals with no present hidden ingredients are valid negatives

mean_hidden_questions_per_positive_meal.exclusion: completed meals with at least one present hidden ingredient

question_risk_surface_calorie_weighted_c.exclusion: weights hidden-positive meals by their measured hidden kcal; any hidden question surfaces risk but not identity

question_risk_surface_case_recall.exclusion: identity need not match; metric means some hidden risk reached a user question

question_risk_surface_false_positive_rat.exclusion: only hidden_truth_complete meals with no present hidden ingredients are valid negatives

recognition_risk_surface_calorie_weighte.exclusion: weights hidden-positive meals by their measured hidden kcal; does not claim ingredient identity

recognition_risk_surface_case_recall.exclusion: denominator is completed meals with at least one ground-truth hidden ingredient

recognition_risk_surface_false_positive_.exclusion: only hidden_truth_complete meals with no present hidden ingredients are valid negatives

silent_hidden_risk_case_rate.exclusion: hidden-positive meals with no generated HIDDEN_INGREDIENT question

question_stage_semantics: oracle-progressed staged state; measures hidden-question reachability after resolvable earlier blockers are progressed
scope: development-only hidden ingredient identity and risk-surfacing analysis
